definitions.explanation: Describes a substance, drug, or effect that reduces inflammation in the body. Used mainly in medical, pharmaceutical, and health-food contexts, often as a modifier in compounds like {抗炎症薬|こうえんしょうやく} (anti-inflammatory drug) or {抗炎症作用|こうえんしょうさよう} (anti-inflammatory action).

examples.japanese: {抗炎症|こうえんしょう}⟦{作用|さよう}→作用：05761_sayou⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧。
{抗炎症|こうえんしょう}{薬|やく}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{処方|しょほう}→処方：05976_shohou⟧⟦された→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: I was prescribed an anti-inflammatory drug.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦ハーブ→ハーブ：11246_haabu⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{抗炎症|こうえんしょう}⟦{効果|こうか}→効果：02726_kouka⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{言|い}われている→言う：00515_iu⟧。
examples.english: This herb is said to have anti-inflammatory properties.

examples.japanese: ⟦{医師|いし}→医師：11851_ishi⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧、{腫|は}れ⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{抑|おさ}える→抑える：12806_osaeru⟧⟦ため→ため：01145_tame⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{抗炎症|こうえんしょう}⟦{剤|ざい}→〜剤：30790_zai⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{使|つか}う→使う：00473_tsukau⟧よう⟦{勧|すす}めた→勧める：02120_susumeru⟧。
examples.english: The doctor recommended using an anti-inflammatory agent to suppress the swelling.

notes:
Composed of {抗|こう} (resist, counter) and ⟦{炎症|えんしょう}→炎症：05978_enshou⟧ (inflammation). Almost always appears as a modifier in compounds rather than as a standalone noun, describing drugs, foods, or biological actions that reduce inflammation.

USAGE:
This is a technical term used in medical, pharmaceutical, and nutritional contexts. It does not normally stand alone; speakers combine it with a following noun such as {薬|やく}, ⟦{剤|ざい}→〜剤：30790_zai⟧, ⟦{作用|さよう}→作用：05761_sayou⟧, or ⟦{効果|こうか}→効果：02726_kouka⟧.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {抗炎症|こうえんしょう}⟦{作用|さよう}→作用：05761_sayou⟧: anti-inflammatory action
- {抗炎症|こうえんしょう}{薬|やく}: anti-inflammatory drug
- {抗炎症|こうえんしょう}⟦{剤|ざい}→〜剤：30790_zai⟧: anti-inflammatory agent
- {抗炎症|こうえんしょう}⟦{効果|こうか}→効果：02726_kouka⟧: anti-inflammatory effect
- {抗炎症|こうえんしょう}⟦{成分|せいぶん}→成分：04344_seibun⟧: anti-inflammatory ingredient

RELATED WORDS:
- ⟦{炎症|えんしょう}→炎症：05978_enshou⟧: inflammation — the condition this word counters
- {消炎|しょうえん}: reducing inflammation — a near-synonym used in drug names like {消炎鎮痛剤|しょうえんちんつうざい}
- ⟦{抗生物質|こうせいぶっしつ}→抗生物質：11089_kouseibusshitsu⟧: antibiotic — a different category of medication
- ⟦{解熱剤|げねつざい}→解熱剤：09713_genetsuzai⟧: fever reducer — often paired with anti-inflammatories in over-the-counter medicines
